The four timers can be independently configured (i.e., clock divider, and counter overflow value) and each internally maintains a timebase counter (i.e., a counter that counts on cycles of a reference clock).
Each PWM generator will select one of the timers and uses the timer's counter value as a reference to generate its PWM signal.
